**The build passes now.** Two real bugs, not noise.

1. `src/core/options.js` read `options.retries`. The bump renamed it `retryCount`. It now accepts either.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` threw on an unset flag. Unset now means off, like before.

The 8 warnings are printed by the bundler itself. Fixing those means touching the packages.
